competing_predictions_required: value/readout failure despite apparently consistent retrieval
before_algorithm_codegen: Record exact missing capability and mainline call sites; no copied parallel detector

Pin RoPE/GQA/masking/precision and cache identities; qualify numerical replay
Specify a discriminating comparison and negative outcomes, not just a new score name
Record an independent design review and module-level scope
Preserve complete fact identity (subject,predicate,time/scope/polarity); subject-only aggregation is a marginal diagnostic
Relation error need not identify one uniquely wrong token; freeze projection to original token/span before evaluation truth
before_any_run: Use implemented entrypoint and real source/data SHA bindings
Run research_memory.py check; reuse or recover existing evidence when indicated
Claim the exact approved run before launch; no model experiment on a plan-only record
Freeze method/config/population/score outputs before opening evaluation truth
memory_scope: check/claim/finish supervise identity, duplicates and evidence; they are not an automatic scientific novelty or semantic validity judge.
